description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, including cloning repositories, fetching diffs from GitHub, extracting changed files, and validating repository info. It is part of backend utilities for managing repository data and diffs.

methods.name: partial_clone
methods.description: Clones the diff between two commits, applying pre-MVP filtering, and saves files to the repository directory.

methods.name: get_diff_from_github
methods.description: Uses the GitHub API to compare commits between the current version of the repo on the server and the version on GitHub.

methods.name: create_changed_files_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of changed files based on the GitHub API JSON response.

methods.name: get_latest_repo_data_from_github
methods.description: Downloads the latest repository data as a zip file from GitHub.

methods.name: extract_files
methods.description: Extracts filtered source code files from a zip archive into the repository directory.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a repository, purging existing directory if necessary.

methods.name: extract_and_validate_repo_info
methods.description: Extracts and validates repository information from incoming request data.
